title: Salesforce Debug Log Events
description: Schema for tracking Salesforce debug log event types, their categories, levels, and source attributions

$schema.description: Reference to this JSON Schema file

version.description: Semantic version of the data file

last_updated.description: ISO date when the file was last updated

sources.description: Lookup of source identifiers to source metadata

categories.description: Debug log categories (correspond to Salesforce trace flag categories)

releases.description: Lookup of release keys to release metadata

log_levels.description: Ordered list of debug log levels from least to most verbose

log_structure.description: Structural metadata about the debug log format, size limits, and retention

code_unit_types.description: Types of work delimited by CODE_UNIT_STARTED/CODE_UNIT_FINISHED

events.description: All known debug log event types

url.description: URL to the source, or an org-relative template such as ${org_url}/path

type.description: Source type: official (Salesforce docs), community (third-party), manual (observed in logs)

last_checked.description: Date this source was last scraped, whether or not anything changed

api_version.description: Salesforce API version the doc version corresponds to, e.g. '67.0'

event_count.description: Number of events this source stated at the last check

name.description: API name of the category (matches Salesforce trace flag category names)

description.description: Brief description of what events in this category cover

default_level.description: Default log level when no trace flags are active (from Debug Log Order of Precedence). Null if not documented.

api_version.description: Salesforce API version (e.g. '62.0' or '<62.0' for pre-release)

date.description: Approximate release date in YYYY-MM format

event.description: Event type name as it appears in debug logs

category.description: Debug log category this event belongs to, or null if uncategorized

level.description: Minimum log level required to capture this event, or null if unknown

fields.description: Fields/data included in the log line for this event

description.description: Brief description of what this event logs

sources.description: Source identifiers where this event is documented

official.description: True if this event appears in official Salesforce documentation (S1 or S2)

release_added.description: Release key when this event was first documented, or null if unknown

release_deprecated.description: Release key when this event was deprecated, or null if still active

last_verified.description: ISO date when this event was last verified in its sources

notes.description: Any additional notes about this event

truncation_protected.description: True if this event is never removed during log truncation (per official Salesforce docs). Note: content between protected start/end pairs may still be removed.

source_levels.description: Level and category reported by each source (S1, S2, S3, S6). The top-level level/category fields reflect the resolved value. Null when no source provides level data (e.g. S4/S5-only events).
